programmes.d: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.
Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.
A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).
Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.
A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.
Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.
A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.
A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.
Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.
An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.
The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.
